units.lanesOrWidth: < 2 = continuous movement, value is the play width as a fraction of the visible width at the pet's depth; integer >= 2 = that many lanes
units.spawn.rampPower: curve exponent on round progress p (0..1): 1 = linear, > 1 = slow start
units.fallSpeed.*: visible play heights per second (screen-relative, same feel on phone and desktop)
units.move.keySpeed: play widths per second while an arrow key is held
units.move.followPerSec: smoothing rate toward the pointer/hand target, 1/s (higher = snappier)
units.items.*.weight: relative spawn weight; demon weight ramps from 0 after graceSec over rampSec
units.items.*.points: score per catch, before the streak multiplier (demon points are a flat penalty, not multiplied)
units.coinsPerPoints: points per 1 bonus coin at round end (floor)
units.needs.*: need level delta (0..1 scale) on round end, scaled by the fraction of the round played; fun also x persona playGain
